adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"` and an `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` that only re-renders `@embedding` without applying any params (no persistence). The admin controller also defines an action `saveChanges() { this.get('embedding').update({}); }`, which would result in a PUT that has no effect beyond returning the serialized embedding. However, the provided `embedding.hbs` template doesn’t invoke `saveChanges`, and host changes are persisted via the separate `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`, so this is more an incomplete/placeholder endpoint than a currently broken behavior in the shown UI.
